chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Nusayr, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I heard him saying: 'When the Imam finishes (the prayer), one should not pray in his place until he moves away from that place.'
ai.seo_question: What should worshippers do after the Imam finishes the prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the etiquette of *khuluw* (clearing the space) after the Imam's *salam*, ensuring the congregation does not rush to occupy the Imam's specific spot before he has moved. In Shia fiqh, this practice underscores the hierarchical respect for the Imam and prevents confusion or crowding in the prayer rows, reflecting the broader principle of orderly conduct (*adab*) in communal worship.
